title: 7 Things to Know About the New Insane White House Press Secretary
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Katie Zacharia [took to the podium
today](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/trumps-new-white-house-
press-secretary-katie-zacharia-first-briefing-rcna602948) for her first White
House press briefing since being named Karoline Leavitt's replacement,
officially becoming Donald Trump's sixth press secretary since he first took
office in 2016.

And it was a disaster of a debut. Zacharia ended the briefing after about 15
minutes, only having answered three questions and accidentally
[calling](https://x.com/atrupar/status/2110007535608479995) her husband "my
president." Yikes.

But her abysmal performance isn't the most concerning thing about her.

And as mainstream media is already normalizing her as the newest voice of the
Trump administration, **Zeteo** is not.

So here are seven things you need to know about Katie Zacharia, the newest
insane member of this insane administration:
